verses.text: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming, not the real things themselves. So the same sacrifices, offered year after year, can never make perfect those who come to worship.
If they could, people would have stopped offering them. The worshippers would have been made clean once, and would no longer feel guilty for their sins.
Instead, those sacrifices remind people of their sins every year.
The blood of bulls and goats can never take away sins.
That is why, when Christ came into the world, he said to God, "You did not want sacrifices and offerings, but you prepared a body for me.
You were not pleased with burnt offerings or sacrifices for sin.
Then I said, 'Here I am, O God. I have come to do what you want, just as the scroll says about me.'"
First he said, "You did not want sacrifices, offerings, burnt offerings or sacrifices for sin, and you were not pleased with them," even though the law asks for them.
Then he said, "Here I am. I have come to do what you want." So he takes away the first way to set up the second.
Because Jesus Christ did what God wanted, and offered his body once for all time, we have been made holy.
Every priest stands day after day doing his work, offering the same sacrifices again and again. But they can never take away sins.
But Christ offered one sacrifice for sins, for all time. Then he sat down at the right hand of God.
Now he is waiting until God puts his enemies under his feet.
By that one offering, he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.
The Holy Spirit also tells us this. First he says,
"This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their hearts, and write them on their minds."
Then he says, "I will never again remember their sins and the wrong things they have done."
When sins have been forgiven, there is no more need for an offering for sin.
So, brothers and sisters, because of the blood of Jesus, we can now go boldly into the Most Holy Place.
Jesus opened a new way for us, a way that gives life. He opened it through the curtain, that is, through his own body.
And we have a great Priest who is in charge of God's house.
So let us come close to God with an honest heart and full faith. Our hearts have been sprinkled clean from a guilty conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
Let us hold on firmly to the hope we say we have, without doubting, because God can be trusted to keep his promise.
Let us think about how we can encourage each other to love and to do good things.
Let us not stop meeting together, as some people have done. Instead, let us encourage each other, and do it even more as you see the Day of the Lord coming closer.
If we keep on sinning on purpose after we have learned the truth, there is no other sacrifice left to take away sins.
All that is left is a terrible fear of judgment, and of the raging fire that will destroy God's enemies.
Anyone who refused to obey the law of Moses was put to death without mercy, if two or three witnesses spoke against them.

So think how much worse the punishment will be for those who walk all over the Son of God! They treat the blood of the covenant, which made them holy, as if it were worthless, and they insult the Spirit who gives God's kindness.
We know God, who said, "I will punish people. I will pay them back." He also said, "The Lord will judge his people."
It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
Remember the early days, after you first came to know the truth. You stayed strong through a hard fight and much suffering.
Sometimes you were insulted and treated badly in front of everyone. At other times you stood beside others who were treated like that.
You felt for those who were in prison, and you were glad when your things were taken from you, because you knew you had something better that will last forever.
So do not throw away your courage. It will bring you a great reward.
You need to keep going, so that after you have done what God wants, you will receive what he promised.
For the Scripture says, "In just a little while, the one who is coming will come. He will not wait.
My people who do what is right will live by faith. But if they turn back, I will not be pleased with them."
But we are not people who turn back and are destroyed. We are people who have faith and are saved.
